title: Well There's Your Problem | Episode 46 : Five-over-Ones
summary: An episode of the Well There's Your Problem podcast on five-over-one buildings, wood-frame floors atop concrete bases, with engineering background and some oil industry news. It is long, rambling and has NSFW language.
why: Recommended in housing and architecture threads for its engineers' critique of five-over-one construction.

quote.text: Here's an enlightening chapter of "Well there's your problem" podcast about this with actual civil engineers
